# Hero Points

The English twin, through the English spelling of the section: a `## Front` section is the card, this intro is not.

## Front

At the start of each session every character gains **1 Hero Point**, up to 3.

### Spending them

| Points | Effect |
|---|---|
| 1 | reroll a check, keep the second result |
| all | avoid death: stabilise at 0 HP |
| — | unspent points are lost at the session's end |
